title: Implement topic and document mode detection
description: Add mode detection over paragraphs and list structure using editorial_text helpers, exposing mode per section so rule checks can select the right limits.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented _asd_topic_modes paragraph classification (list markers or imperative-initial first token -> procedure; explicit config mode applies to all topics) and _asd_document_mode for the summary detectedMode field; schema accepts optional detectedMode.
